decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample offset in N/E/U near the end of the first window (indices ~536–544), and (2) a prolonged high-magnitude phase from index 605 onward featuring possible platform behavior and ambiguous return near the final samples. Cross-axis shapes show superposed trends and abrupt changes without clear single-event resolution.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 539–542, with U also decreasing; appears as a rapid offset rather than smooth motion. Preceded by relatively stable behavior, followed by continued drift at new level.

Sustained high-amplitude, irregular motion from ~605 onward, especially in E and U, with apparent platform-like behavior between ~680–710 (E ~14–16, U ~-15 to -17), then abrupt shift downward in E and upward in U near 725–729. Overlapping changes make return ambiguous.
